svg.title: KeurBon Non-Custodial Purpose-Locked Voucher Architecture
svg.desc: End-to-end cryptographic flow from Paris Diaspora Sender to Cashu Mint (NUT-4 and NUT-11 P2PK lock), compact QR/SMS voucher delivery to family in Dakar, offline NUT-12 DLEQ verification and Schnorr redemption at the Dakar neighborhood vendor counter, zero-PII Nostr kind 30078 fulfillment receipt publication, and NUT-7 spend check or post-expiry sender refund.
svg.text: Cashu NUT-11 P2PK Vendor Lock · Offline NUT-12 DLEQ Mint-Signature Check · Zero-PII Nostr Kind 30078 Receipts
Zero Custodial Backend · Direct Browser-to-Mint HTTPS & Browser-to-Relay WSS

g.text: • Keeps local secp256k1 refund private key
• Mints blind-signed sat proofs with NUT-12 DLEQ
• Enforces NUT-11 P2PK spending conditions on swap
Blind signatures: mint never sees family identity or goods
• Sent to family via WhatsApp, SMS, or print
• Earmarked for named Dakar vendor only
Parses NUT-11 P2PK lock & verifies NUT-12
DLEQ signature against cached mint keyset
Signs proofs with vendor secp256k1 private
key to swap for fresh unlocked sats
Zero personal names, phone numbers, or street addresses
Fetches kind 30078 by voucher sha256 d-tag
or verifies raw JSON offline via BIP-340
If unspent past locktime, sender reclaims
sats automatically with refund private key.
